# DataForSEO AI Keyword Search Volume API

Estimated search volume of keywords inside AI tools such as ChatGPT and AI Overviews.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/ai_optimization/ai_keyword_data/keywords_search_volume/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/ai_optimization/ai_keyword_data/keywords_search_volume/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keywords": ["chatgpt", "seo tools"], "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `keywords` | Array of keywords (up to 1,000). |
| `location_code` | Location code, e.g. 2840 for the United States. |
| `language_code` | Language code, e.g. "en". |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/ai_optimization/ai_keyword_data/keywords_search_volume/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.0102 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
